root_cause.text: The swap address space was incorrectly marked read-only (__ro_after_init), but the code path during swap writeback under memory pressure can write error tracking data via errseq_set to that address space, causing a kernel panic when the write triggers a page fault on read-only memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch reverts the declaration from `__ro_after_init` to `__read_mostly` (in both `swap.h` and `swap_state.c`), and the CVE description identifies the panic trace starting at `errseq_set` within `__filemap_set_wb_err` during `shrink_folio_list`, with the root cause being that the swap address space was made read-only by commit 8b47299a411a.
